messages.title: Introduce yourself
messages.text: Hi, my name is {name} and I am one of the controllers here today.

messages.title: Introduce yourself (mentor present)
messages.text: Hi, my name is {name}. I am currently being mentored by {mentor} on {callsign}, so you may hear a second voice on frequency.

messages.title: Introduce yourself (under training)
messages.text: Hi, my name is {name} and I am a trainee controller on {callsign}. Thanks in advance for your patience.

messages.title: Readback required
messages.text: {recipient}, a full readback of the clearance is required. My name is {name} if you have any questions.

messages.title: Use your callsign
messages.text: {recipient}, please include your full callsign on every transmission so I can identify you on frequency.

messages.title: Squawk mode C
messages.text: {recipient}, please ensure your transponder is set to mode C so I can see your altitude.

messages.title: Monitor UNICOM after leaving
messages.text: {recipient}, when you leave my frequency please monitor UNICOM on 122.800 and broadcast your intentions.

messages.title: Hello to adjacent controller
messages.text: Hi {recipient}, {name} here on {callsign}. Give me a shout if you need anything.

messages.title: Request a break
messages.text: Hi {recipient}, {name} on {callsign}. I need to step away for about {minutes} minutes at {time}Z - are you able to cover?

messages.title: Closing the position
messages.text: {recipient}, I am closing {callsign} shortly. Please monitor UNICOM on 122.800 after leaving my frequency. Thanks for flying with us - {name}.

messages.title: Thanks for flying
messages.text: Thanks for flying with {callsign} today, have a good one. - {name}
